narrative.overview: A controlled operations room seen through a premium product lens: near-black space, precise typography, decisive red fields, and metal-edged interface surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained signal red on coal-black surfaces
Wide editorial spacing with asymmetric compositions
One cinematic motion sequence with fast micro-interactions elsewhere

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Red is a scarce directional cue and focused light source, never a page-wide neon wash.

rules.name: The Bounded Light Rule
rules.body: Glow belongs behind the laptop or the final CTA atmosphere and must not reduce copy contrast.

dos: Do label illustrative automation interfaces as demo content.
Do use transform, opacity, and bounded filter effects for motion.
donts: Don't introduce cyberpunk grids, Matrix motifs, particle rain, or crypto styling.
Don't add unverified metrics, logos, testimonials, or service claims.
